bible.title: The Last Call
bible.logline: A night-shift 911 dispatcher takes a call from a terrified woman hiding in her own house, and the address she whispers is the dispatcher's.

cast.name: Maya
cast.look: Latina woman, shoulder-length dark brown hair tied back loosely with loose strands at the temples, tired warm brown eyes, a faint thin scar through her left eyebrow, small gold hoop earrings
cast.wardrobe: a navy-blue dispatcher polo shirt with a round county emergency services patch, a black headset with a boom microphone, a lanyard ID badge

cast.name: Cole
cast.look: broad-shouldered white man, close-cropped grey hair, short grey stubble, deep-set blue eyes, a weathered kind face
cast.wardrobe: a light-blue uniform shirt with the sleeves rolled up, a loosened dark tie, a supervisor badge clipped to his belt

cast.name: The Other Maya
cast.look: exactly the same woman as Maya, same face and scar, but soaking wet: dark hair plastered to her cheeks, pale bluish skin, water dripping from her chin, dark hollow eyes, no headset
cast.wardrobe: the same navy-blue dispatcher polo shirt, drenched and streaked with river mud

locations.name: Dispatch Center
locations.sound: late-night office room tone, computer hum, soft rain on a window
locations.look: a county 911 dispatch room at 3 AM: rows of desks with several glowing monitors each, most chairs empty, dim overhead lights, cold blue screen light, rain streaking a large dark window, a wall clock reading 3:07

episode.title: Forty-One Alder Lane
episode.hook_line: He's inside my house. He's standing at the foot of my bed.
episode.cliffhanger: Maya turns around and sees herself, drowned, standing in the dark.

shots.action: Maya sits alone at the only lit desk in the dark dispatch room, rain running down the window behind her
an incoming 911 line light blinks red on the switchboard and a woman's finger presses the answer button

shots.speaker: The Other Maya
shots.line: He's inside my house. He's standing at the foot of my bed.
shots.action: a call screen with a jagged audio waveform pulsing, caller ID unknown, cold blue light

shots.speaker: Maya
shots.line: Ma'am, stay quiet. What's your address?

shots.speaker: The Other Maya
shots.action: Maya's eyes widen and her breath stops

shots.speaker: Maya
shots.action: Maya freezes, staring at the screen, one hand slowly rising to her mouth

shots.speaker: Cole
shots.line: Reyes? You look like you've seen a ghost.
shots.action: Cole walks up holding two paper cups of coffee

shots.speaker: Maya
shots.line: Cole, send a unit to forty-one Alder Lane. Now.

shots.speaker: The Other Maya
shots.action: Maya presses the headset to her ear, listening, frightened

shots.speaker: Maya
shots.line: How do you know my name?

shots.speaker: The Other Maya
shots.line: Because I'm you. And you never made it home tonight.
shots.action: Maya's headset lying on the desk, rain shadows sliding over it, the call timer still running

shots.speaker: Maya
shots.line: No. No, I'm right here. I'm at work.

shots.speaker: Cole
shots.line: Maya... there's no call. That line's been dead for an hour.

shots.speaker: The Other Maya
shots.action: Maya's eyes slide sideways, terrified, a drop of water lands on her shoulder
Maya slowly turns in her chair; at the far end of the dark room the other Maya stands motionless, soaking wet, water pooling at her feet

shots.speaker: The Other Maya
shots.line: You never left the river, Maya.
